# ha-gatekeeper

> A reliability-first MCP server for Home Assistant that implements the "LLM as an untrusted advisor" architecture. Interposes a four-tier deterministic policy engine (unrestricted, logged, confirmed, prohibited) between an LLM's intent and Home Assistant's execution layer. Every action is classified, authorised, rate-limited, and audited. Built with TypeScript, Node.js 20+, and the MCP SDK v1.x using Streamable HTTP transport.

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://github.com/antnewman/ha-gatekeeper/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): Installation, configuration walkthrough, running the server, connecting MCP clients, and verification steps
- [Configuration Reference](https://github.com/antnewman/ha-gatekeeper/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): Full reference for config.yaml including all fields, types, defaults, tier assignment guide, and constraint setup
- [Architecture](https://github.com/antnewman/ha-gatekeeper/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Four-layer design, request flow, policy engine resolution order, circuit breaker state machine, audit log schema, and Prometheus metrics

- [README](https://github.com/antnewman/ha-gatekeeper/blob/main/README.md): Project overview, feature summary, tool reference, and quick start

## Source Code

- [src/config/schema.ts](https://github.com/antnewman/ha-gatekeeper/blob/main/src/config/schema.ts): Zod schema defining the configuration structure and validation rules
- [src/config/loader.ts](https://github.com/antnewman/ha-gatekeeper/blob/main/src/config/loader.ts): YAML config loading with environment variable substitution
- [src/execution/ha-client.ts](https://github.com/antnewman/ha-gatekeeper/blob/main/src/execution/ha-client.ts): Home Assistant WebSocket client wrapper with entity state cache
- [src/types/policy.ts](https://github.com/antnewman/ha-gatekeeper/blob/main/src/types/policy.ts): Policy engine type definitions (tiers, decisions, constraints)
